title: GTA 6 Map Poster Leak Reveals New Parts of Leonida
description: The GTA 6 map poster leaked through a Collector's Edition unboxing video, showing Lummox County, Moreau and Pelican Valley in Leonida, per NewsBytes.

body.text: A GTA 6 map poster has leaked, and it shows parts of Leonida that fans have not seen before. According to NewsBytes, which cites Notebookcheck, an Instagram account posted an unboxing video of the game's Collector's Edition, and the printed poster inside gives the first official look at most of the state's regions and their labels. For a game this anticipated, a clear look at the map matters.
What the GTA 6 map poster shows
The unboxing video is from the Goodtime State - Vice City Collection. The poster inside shows several areas that were not known before, per the report.

items: Lummox County, located in the north of the map.
Pelican Valley, further south within the Grassrivers region.
Toll roads, which match a detail from the game's Netflix Extended Look trailer.
A blimp icon on the map.

body.text: The toll road marking is a useful detail. It suggests the printed map lines up with what Rockstar has already shown in its own footage, though the report does not say anything more about how toll roads will work.

The physical map is exclusive to the Vice City Collection, which costs $400 on pre-order, according to NewsBytes. That is a steep price for most Indian players, especially with import and shipping questions the report does not address.

Standard physical copies for PS5 and Xbox do not include it. That breaks from earlier Rockstar games such as GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2. Retail boxes instead carry a double-sided poster with cover art.

There is a fallback for everyone else. NewsBytes reports that Rockstar Games plans to offer a downloadable digital version of the map on or shortly after the game's release date. Players who skip the Collector's Edition should not be locked out of the map entirely.
Community mapping project hit by a DMCA strike

The leak comes while the GTA 6 Mapping Project is reportedly under pressure. This community effort built a map of Vice City and Leonida using trailers and screenshots. Its Discord server reportedly received a DMCA strike, possibly from Take-Two Interactive or Rockstar Games. The source does not confirm who filed it, so treat the origin as unverified.
The project's website is still active, according to the report. Its members are likely to go through the Instagram footage for more clues about the game's large world.

Keep an eye on whether Rockstar confirms the digital map and when it will arrive, since that decides how most players get the full picture of Leonida. Also watch how the mapping community uses the new labels, and whether more unboxing footage of the Collector's Edition appears. Until Rockstar says more, the poster is the clearest look at the state so far, and it comes from a leak rather than an official reveal.

faqs.q: What is the GTA 6 map poster?
faqs.a: It is a printed poster of the fictional state of Leonida that comes with the Goodtime State - Vice City Collection, the game's Collector's Edition, according to NewsBytes. An unboxing video on Instagram showed it and revealed most regions and their labels.

faqs.q: Do standard copies of GTA 6 include the map poster?
faqs.a: No. According to NewsBytes, standard physical copies for PS5 and Xbox include a double-sided poster with cover art instead. Rockstar Games reportedly plans a downloadable digital map on or shortly after release.

faqs.q: How much does the GTA 6 Collector's Edition with the map cost?
faqs.a: The Vice City Collection, which includes the physical map, costs $400 on pre-order, according to NewsBytes. The report does not give an Indian price.
